book.title: Sarra and the Little Lost Roar
book.description: An original watercolor listening adventure made for Sarra. A little lion has lost his roar; a friend who listens helps him find his courage. English and French.

arPages.purpose: Meet the cub in the sunlit listening woodland.
An original little songbird flutters its wings over the printed page.
Look up to find Owl on a low branch, then turn toward the sound of the brook.
Look around the reeds and shallow brook before the friends find the source of the voice.
A small original animated tortoise takes gentle brave steps.
The original cub breathes calmly as he chooses to help his friend.
See the small tortoise on the fallen branch and look down at the stream crossing.
Return to the same brook at golden hour, with the cub on the bank and the crossing nearby.

typography.sounds: Fredoka 700, existing app colored sound words
typography.note: Story text stays editable and is typeset by the app, never baked into spread artwork.
